desc:
The Multiverse Project (formerly Comedy World RP Fixed)
A diverse roleplaying experience where you can:
🌌 Roleplay as your favorite characters
🌍 Explore maps from various fandoms
🖼️ Morph into custom images from a huge image library
✨ Create stories with friends!
